cockpit.name: Cockpit
cockpit.damaged: Dust dims the glass. The navigation console has only a little power.
cockpit.restored: Clean glass and steady instruments. A brighter view of the journey ahead.
damaged_objects: Burnt display pixels; guidance is offline.
A film of dust catches the starlight.
Worn padding, still a place to rest.
restored_objects: The repaired console traces a quiet star map.
Freshly cleaned glass frames the stars.
New teal padding makes a comfortable perch.

quarters.name: Living quarters
quarters.damaged: A threadbare bunk and a dangling cable. There is room for a little warmth.
quarters.restored: Fresh bedding, a repaired lamp and one small plant. This is becoming home.
damaged_objects: A faded blanket covers the old bunk.
A few abandoned containers gather dust.
The dock is worn but safe to use during study sessions.
restored_objects: A soft blue blanket is ready for a break.
A little green plant reaches toward the lamp.
The tidy dock pulses gently while your companion studies with you.

engine.name: Engine room
engine.damaged: The old coils are burnt out. The ship drifts quietly without propulsion.
engine.restored: Coolant flows and the coils glow. The ship finally has a heartbeat.
damaged_objects: Burnt coils need a careful replacement.
The coolant line is dark and silent.
A loose cover and a few rusty fasteners.
restored_objects: Fresh coils produce a steady turquoise glow.
A gentle pulse follows the repaired coolant line.
Clean fasteners hold the panel securely in place.
